verdict.rationale: Release notes show Bruno has its own environment selector dropdown and a CLI flag to override global environment variables at runtime, which implies switchable environment variable sets. The evidence consists only of thin changelog lines, with no first-party docs describing per-environment variable sets. A community comment hoping for 'separate environments' is a wish, not a concrete counter-example. Missing for 10: documentation of defining dev/staging/prod environment variable sets, an explicit description of switching environments in the app and CLI, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can switch requests between dev, staging, and prod using environment variable sets

citations.quote: adding search filter to environment selector dropdown
add --global-env-var to override global environment variables at runtime
